name: Trips - Left - 48 Sweep

SL.rule: At the snap run flat across the backfield, take the handoff at full speed and get to the right edge. Turn up in the alley behind the tailback.

QB.rule: Hand the ball to the slot as he runs past you, then fake the handoff to the tailback going left.

TB.how: Bubble out around the right end

coaching_points: The slot and the split end start left together. The slot comes across; the split end cuts off behind him.
The tailback leads out to the right and takes the corner. The slot stays behind him and turns up in the alley.
